name: Albanian Open 2019
information:
*[EN]*

The competition will also be positioned as Albanian National Championship 2019. So fastest Albanian competitors per event will be honoured as national champions.

Kampjonati do te vendoset gjithashtu si Albanian National Championship 2019. Kjo do te thote se garuesit me te shpejte nga Shqiperia do ti jepet titulli kampjon kombetar.
